_comment: Carvera aluminium inventory: aluminium-relevant subset of Essential Milling Bit Set - Standard (26 pcs), supplemented with Makera 4/6 mm metal O-flute cutters and supplementary catalogue tools: Harvey long-flute miniature cutter for deep small corners, pointed engraver, spot drill and long M3 single-form mill; Guhring3.3mm drill for deep pilots, not a claim that six cutting bits ship with the machine. Read 2026-11-09: https://global.makera.com/products/carvera-tool-kits confirms a free starter toolkit but does not itemise bits; https://core-electronics.com.au/guides/cnc-milling/getting-started-with-the-makera-carvera-setup-and-first-cut/ lists mixed-material starter tools and a test rod in slot 6. Use the itemised 26-pc set instead: https://core-electronics.com.au/makera-common-milling-bits-26-pcs.html . Optional 1/4 inch maximum capacity configuration; matching collets and manual changes are required, see machine comment. Geometry and Aluminum presets read directly from Makera Fusion libraries (per-tool URLs), facts transcribed, no vendor files redistributed. Aluminum is a generic preset, not specifically 6082. Ball ends omitted: no resources/camlib adapter type. Corn/wood bits omitted. M5 has a 4 mm cutting head on a 3.175 mm shank. Inventory exceeds six pockets; load per setup. All source read dates 2026-11-09. Shared inventory: no fixture-specific supplied decisions or stock-grid override. No taps: Makera's published Carvera specifications, manual/software page https://wiki.makera.com/en/carvera/manual/software and profiles https://github.com/MakeraInc/CarveraProfiles were checked 2026-11-09; no documented rigid-tapping/spindle-feed synchronization capability was found. This is not a claim that no firmware could support it. Carvera estimated cutting times remain limited by Makera's conservative aluminium presets until #38/#37.

machines.name: the Makera Carvera
machines._comment: Read 2026-11-09 https://www.makera.com/products/carvera : travel 360x240x140 mm, spindle 200 W / 15000 rpm, custom integrated 1/8 inch collet (optional 1/4 inch, 6/4/3 mm), tool library size 6, maximum travel speed 6000 mm/min. Configured for optional 1/4 inch maximum shank capacity (6.35 mm). Inventory also requires matching 6 mm, 4 mm, 3 mm and 1/8 inch collets; a 1/4 inch collet does not grip these smaller shanks. Manual collet changes are required; the schema checks maximum shank capacity, not mixed-collet ATC compatibility. Placeholder vise: rectangular jaws, thickness conservatively equal to height; not validated workholding. Manual spindle-collet changes: Makera How To Change the Spindle Collet, read 2026-11-09 https://wiki.makera.com/en/carvera/How-To (video https://youtu.be/J8edCDsmz8I). Different shanks need matching collets or verified bit-collet adapters; no adapters are assumed in this inventory. The ATC swaps collared tools, not spindle collets.

required_output_units.note: G21 millimetres; G20 unsupported/halts, as also recorded in docs/carvera.md. Community firmware documentation, not a verified installed firmware version.

controller_settings._comment: Unknown: maximum cutting feed (6000 mm/min is travel speed, not a verified cutting limit), addressable tool/offset ranges, final position after M6, acceleration/axis feed limits and collision geometry. Optional-stop mode exists in community firmware but installed state is unknown. Rigid tapping not established. No controller post exists yet. The existing rapid5000 is step2cam time-estimate policy; do not silently replace it with catalogue travel6000. G53 Z-3 in profiles is a commanded retract, not proof of final M6 gauge position.

_policy: step2cam judgement: end-mill stepover 0.4D (Makera does not enable end-mill stepover; its engraving/chamfer presets do specify stepover); stickout=Fusion assemblyGaugeLength, treated as tool projection, holder_length=10 mm and holder_diameter=8 mm are conservative collar/collet envelopes, not measured assemblies. Coolant off follows disabled presets; use external air assist for chip evacuation (machine air capability is separate; schema has no air tool coolant). Thread presets have contradictory flood/disabled expression: use off, not flood on this machine. Thread radial_passes=2, spring_passes=1 are step2cam judgement; published LCF is used as axial tooth envelope, not a measured single tooth. Global allowances/clearances/tolerances and rapid=5000 remain step2cam judgement (below sourced 6000 mm/min travel speed). End-mill RPM/feed round Fusion conversion noise to nearest integer.
